reads: brand brain: summary, kit, products (our price and offer), competitors, learnings, organic, sources (brand_read) — learn-my-brand / server research
claims through the claims-gate atom (learn-my-brand's contract) — learn-my-brand
competitor roster, dossiers and suggestions (competitor_read) — research-market seeds it; server research fills it

competitor Meta ads: server sample (ads_template_read mode competitor; media_list tag competitor_ad) and the full active library of the top 3 rivals (host browser or a paid read through the spend gate)
voice-of-customer bank and segments: workspace research/market/voc-bank.md, personas.md — research-market

angle results by A-NN: workspace reports/performance/<latest>.md and [learning … A-NN] learnings — analyze-performance; creatives tagged angle:a-nn (lower-case) — make-static-ads; video names with the A-NN — make-video-ads
latest search visibility report: workspace search/visibility/<date>.md — improve-search-visibility (optional)
previous competitor files, snapshots and angle bank: workspace research/competitors/* — research-competitors itself
shared price history: workspace research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md — every playbook that spends on data
writes: confirmed competitor set: server roster via competitor_save — read by listen-social, research-market, the app
competitor file (full or 'partial — sample only'): workspace research/competitors/<slug>.md + brand document — read by plan-campaign, make-content (comparison pages), the human
landscape and white space: workspace research/competitors/landscape.md + document — read by plan-campaign, write-my-positioning (backlog)
angle bank keyed by A-NN (makers tag angle:a-nn, lower-case): workspace research/competitors/angle-bank.md + document — read by make-static-ads, make-video-ads, plan-campaign
up to 3 [angle A-NN …] learnings (rules, one idea each) through the save-learning atom, only on the human's yes — read by ad generation
weekly watch digest: workspace research/competitors/watch/<date>.md + document (keep-history) — read by the human and analyze-performance
watch method for the coworker: workspace research/competitors/method/watch.md — read by the standing automation
weekly watch schedule (opt-in, created paused, free sources only): automation_upsert agent job
credits log rows: workspace research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md — read by the next pull of any playbook
